[](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stocks/17494/next-week-earnings-calendar-stocks). **Dollar General**([DG](https://www.kiplinger.com/tfn/ticker.html?ticker=DG)) is scheduled to report fiscal first-quarter results before the opening bell on Tuesday, and the [consumer staples stock](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stocks/best-consumer-staples-stocks-to-buy) has a tough act to follow. Its primary competitor, Dollar Tree ([DLTR](https://www.kiplinger.com/tfn/ticker.html?ticker=DLTR)), [soared 17.9% on May 28](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stocks/snowflake-keeps-the-tech-stock-rally-alive-stock-market-today) on expectations-beating earnings and revenue, plus a new partnership with DoorDash ([DASH](https://www.kiplinger.com/tfn/ticker.html?ticker=DASH)). "While the market's sentiment on the [dollar stores](https://www.kiplinger.com/personal-finance/how-to-save-money/602810/best-things-to-buy-at-dollar-stores-dollar-tree) is cautious, this pessimism has created an opportunity with DG shares.". However, risk appetite among investors rapidly recovered in the latter half of the week amid easing U.S.-Iran tensions, driving gains in the S&P 500, Nasdaq, and [$PHLX Semiconductor Index (.SOX.US)$](https://www.moomoo.com/stock/.SOX-US) rallied sharply once again, while [$Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI.US)$](https://www.moomoo.com/stock/.DJI-US) has reached a record high, signaling a rotation of investment capital from 'defensive pricing' back to 'growth pricing.'. In the software space, performance divergence has become stark: shares of the company that announced strong AI-driven momentum and an expanded partnership with AWS [$Snowflake (SNOW.US)$](https://www.moomoo.com/stock/SNOW-US) surged sharply, while cybersecurity firm [$Zscaler (ZS.US)$](https://www.moomoo.com/stock/ZS-US) plummeted after its revenue outlook fell short of market expectations, reflecting intensified scrutiny of high-valuation SaaS stocks based on earnings performance. [$IBM Corp (IBM.US)$](https://www.moomoo.com/stock/IBM-US) The market welcomed a major investment plan in quantum computing announced by [$Tempus AI (TEM.US)$](https://www.moomoo.com/stock/TEM-US) and in the healthcare sector, AI-driven industrial implementation was positively assessed after the company secured approval from the U.S. FDA (Food and Drug Administration), with its share price trading firmly around $45.00.
